recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If similar failures recur, treat them as website publication or redirect-regeneration work rather than as a FHIR terminology source-definition change.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction requesting that versionless internal CodeSystem URLs stop redirecting to R4 and instead point to R4B or the current versionless specification.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR source commit was found. Zulip shows the problem arose during manual R4B website publication and redirect-file upload, and FHIR-I minutes later record FHIR-37701 as marked closed.
additional_context: The current source redirect template targets versionless http://hl7.org/fhir artifacts, Account and ClinicalUseDefinition are active current-build resources, and their CodeSystem source files still carry the expected canonical URLs. The cited abstract-types code system is absent from current source, so its current 404 is not a missed current-build redirect.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current public checks for account-status and clinical-use-definition-category redirect to /fhir/codesystem-* instead of /fhir/R4/..., and the source templates already express the correct versionless target behavior.
